title: Classifying 12
problem: Which number systems contain the number 12?
solution: 12 is a natural number because it is positive and used for counting. Therefore, it is also a whole number and an integer. Since 12 = 12/1, it is rational. All rational numbers are real.

title: Classifying -7
solution: -7 is not a natural or whole number because it is negative. However, it is an integer. Since -7 = -7/1, it is also rational and real.

title: Classifying 3/5
solution: 3/5 is the ratio of two integers, 3 and 5, with a non-zero denominator. Therefore, it is rational.

title: Classifying √2
solution: √2 cannot be expressed as a ratio of two integers. Its decimal expansion is non-terminating and non-repeating.
